data.comment: Reproduction evidence (2026-10-08, SA-0MUYG0HE6001YTEM implement session): exporting TEST_LOCK_TIMEOUT=3600 to the test process tree deadlocks nested suite subprocesses on the host-wide 'test' semaphore — the outer run holds one slot, another agent holds the other, and the nested run sleeps (hrtimer_nanosleep, ~0 CPU) until the 3600s lock timeout. Observed: implement.py finish full gate hung 2700s; pre-push hook full suite hung 2700s in the main checkout; a plain 'run_tests.py --scope full' from the main checkout hung >700s while the identical suite in a worktree completed in ~722s. Mitigation used: run without TEST_LOCK_TIMEOUT (default 600s bound). Note the live-repo guard false positives under concurrent dev-ref moves are tracked separately (SA-0MUJQ5BPF001PICU).
